headline: Vietnam's GDP Grows Three Times Faster Than the World, Signaling Acceleration at Year-End
summary: Vietnam's GDP grew 9.01% in the first nine months of 2026, versus 2.9% for the world economy, with public investment a key driver and a 10% full-year target.
why: Vietnam is a fast-growing export-oriented economy in Southeast Asia, and its GDP trajectory matters for regional supply chains and emerging-market investors.
